verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Honcho's core is open source and can be fully self-hosted, keeping data on your own infrastructure (honcho-docs-9, honcho-docs-10). That indirectly keeps data out of the vendor's hands, but nothing in the pack states a no-training policy or a training opt-out. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that hosted customer data is not used for model training, a documented training opt-out control for the hosted service, guidance on training exposure via the third-party LLM providers Honcho calls, and independent corroboration.
